description: Gets one invoice by its id: status, amountUsd, reference, dates (createdAt, expiresAt, paidAt), holdReason, networks and the payments received. Needs a store key (npx stablevoy-mcp login). The id comes from create_invoice, list_invoices or the merchant. Without store every connected store is asked; an id no store has gives not_found. To find invoices by status, reference or date, use list_invoices. A failure comes back as an error with its code and what to do, for example rate_limited with the seconds to wait.

store.description: Store id or exact store name from list_stores. Needed only when several stores are connected.

name: get_invoice
title: Read an invoice
